title: An explanation of why spacetime has one time and three space dimensions

concept.text: Strings 2000 problem 5 (proposed by Shamit Kachru, Sunil Mukhi and Hiroshi Ooguri): why does the universe appear to have one time and three space dimensions? Sources given: https://preskill.caltech.edu/millennium.html ; https://aip.brightspotcdn.com/PTO.v54.i10.14_2.online.pdf ; https://x.com/martinmbauer/status/1779906631003697211.

change_log.change: Added by hand to PHY on 2026-11-15.
change_log.reason: One of the ten Physics Problems for the Next Millennium chosen at the Strings 2000 conference (University of Michigan) by a panel of Michael Duff, David Gross and Edward Witten; added at the owner's request, November 14, 2026.
